groups.summary: Platforms, troubleshooting, setup contributor doc (renamed), README surfaces and CHANGELOG tell the one-mode story; the spec-template cascade converges to three tiers; the codex mirror regenerates with the CODEX_HOME-first ladder.
groups.title: Docs sweep and the mirror

proof.label: Full gate
proof.value: 189 test files, 4369 tests, 0 failures; ruff clean; bun test 384/384; mirror idempotent

changeWalkthrough.thesis: Installs go copy-less: every host resolves flowctl from the plugin install via a three-rung chain (env probe, plugin root derived from the loading skill's own path, .flow/bin backstop), setup collapses to one mode that writes zero copies and offers to delete leftovers, and this repo retires its own tracked dogfood copies - plugin updates never require re-running setup again.
